name: orthomcl-all-plasmodium-every-species-reading
turns: Which ortholog groups are present in all Plasmodium species but absent from Toxoplasma gondii?
rationale: The every-species reading counts a species present when most of its strains are: one taxon-count unit per Plasmodium species joined by AND, and every Toxoplasma gondii genome absent.
